paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Yosef son of Rava, in Rav Kahana’s time. Perhaps it is a scribal error and should read Rabbi Abba bar Yosef son of Rava; see his entry. See Nannai above: Nannai and Yannai were interchanged.
